given_when_then.given: A Customer Profile exists with a verified unique identifier and active status
given_when_then.when: An actor initiates the linking of an associated Order Request to the Customer Profile
given_when_then.then: The system successfully links the Order Request to the Customer Profile and updates the audit trail

given_when_then.given: An actor attempts to modify an Archived Customer Profile
given_when_then.when: The actor submits a modification request for any field within the profile
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the modification and preserves all historical data without changes

given_when_then.given: A Customer Profile has unverified contact details
given_when_then.when: The actor attempts to set the profile status to active
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the status change and retains the profile in a pending state

given_when_then.given: A valid Order Request is submitted by an actor
given_when_then.when: The system processes the Order Request and identifies an associated Customer Profile
given_when_then.then: The system links the Order Request to the Customer Profile and records the timestamp and actor in the audit trail

success_criteria: The Customer Profile is linked to the associated Order Request in the system records
The Customer Profile is linked to the Financial Transaction Record in the system records
The Customer Profile contains a unique identifier before any Order Request is associated with it
Contact details within the Customer Profile are verified before the profile status is set to active
Archived Customer Profiles retain all historical data and cannot be modified after archival
Any modification to a Customer Profile is timestamped and attributed to the actor performing the change
The system displays a specific error message when attempting to modify an Archived Customer Profile
The system rejects the update when data fails validation rules for required fields or format
